Postcards

Spin the rack, play the map tour, and collect a postcard from every place you visit.

MYSTERY

Disclosure — The UAP / UFO Files

Real declassified UAP/UFO files from the U.S. government's PURSUE release (war.gov) — Pentagon, CIA, FBI, and NASA records, mapped for you to read and judge.

VISUALIZATION

Theories of Everything

Visually explore the competing theories behind the great questions — each rebuilt as an interactive, animated 3D world you can scrub through time. First up: five theories of how the Pyramids were built.

ADVENTURE

Treasure Hunt

Decode clues on a hand-drawn chart, dig up lost artifacts, and uncover the real history behind them.

MULTIPLAYER

Party World

Hang out with friends by voice in 3D worlds (Gaussian Splat, GLB). Pick your avatar, meet up in a captured world like Chichén Itzá, then walk, fly and wave together.

COMMUNITY

Network States

Fly the globe from Próspera to the Network School — the real startup societies building new countries, one stop at a time.

COMMUNITY
